steps.name: Amazon Customer Service
steps.when_to_use: For issues with defective products and return requests, as the primary point of contact.

steps.name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
steps.channel: Call 1915, SMS/WhatsApp 8800001915, or via the NCH Web Portal
steps.when_to_use: If the company fails to resolve the complaint regarding defective goods or failed returns.

steps.name: Department of Consumer Affairs (Public Grievance Portal)
steps.when_to_use: If the grievance remains unresolved after initial attempts.

steps.name: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
steps.when_to_use: For formal legal action regarding deficiency in service or defective products.

note: Under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, e-commerce entities are prohibited from refusing to take back defective goods or refusing to refund consideration [C1], [C3].
